scenarios.expectedOutcome: An expired durable lease is reclaimed and the previous worker is fenced from acknowledging it.
Redelivery of the same indexing event is idempotent and does not repeat the completed projection side effect.
Expired work is reclaimable, poisoned work is quarantined, and causal descendants remain blocked until operator recovery.
Readiness fails while PostgreSQL is stopped and returns to UP after the service restarts.
Readiness reports raw object storage unavailable while MinIO is stopped and recovers after restart.
Readiness reports the extractor unavailable without treating the API process as live-dead, then recovers after restart.
An explicitly selected unavailable document-intelligence provider fails closed with a capability error.
Embedding writes with the wrong dimensions are rejected by both the lifecycle boundary and database invariant.
A stale embedding generation leaves normal selection and can enter a controlled rebuild lifecycle.
A graph revision that differs from the current corpus disables graph traversal and falls back to permitted channels.
Publication compensates or enters explicit recovery without emitting duplicate or premature durable events.
The core API remains live and ready when no MCP process is present because MCP is a consumer, not a runtime dependency.
The core API remains live and ready when the configured OpenTelemetry collector endpoint is unreachable.
A failure after claim-row mutation but before the coordination event commits rolls back both the claim and event, so no phantom owner survives.
A failed replacement graph build leaves the previous active revision queryable and marks no partial replacement active.
GraphRevisionActivated is emitted durably with causal ordering and generic outbox lease recovery can reclaim delivery after a worker crash without duplicating projection state.
A source withdrawal that changes the truth revision during retrieval fails a STRICT query with CONTEXT_REVISION_CHANGED and stale support is suppressed.
A connector projection failure never advances the source checkpoint and retry exhaustion becomes explicit REJECTED state without a partial object projection.
A remote peer that does not respond before the negotiated wall budget is aborted, returns FEDERATION_PEER_TIMEOUT, and records only a machine-safe failure code.
A normalized compiler provider timeout degrades only when degradationSafe permits it and reuses the same prepared grounded input for the compatible fallback.
A failure while writing a replacement community index rolls back the whole transaction, including the attempted stale transition of the prior active revision.
Bounded PPR work checks a cooperative cancellation hook during iteration and fails with PPR_CANCELLED before completing further scoring work.
A late durable side-effect failure during profile activation rolls back the profile binding and lifecycle transition atomically.
An offline draft captured against an old revision becomes RECONCILE_REQUIRED after reconnect and cannot last-write-wins into workspace state.
Redelivery of the same truth invalidation event reuses the existing projection revision and preserves historical dependencies without duplicate projection state.
The v4 backup restores declared durable state and managed Git into isolated resources, then rebuilds a searchable projection from restored canonical authority.

limitations: Service restart probes exercise deterministic CI stop/start failures rather than long-duration network partitions or managed-service failover.
The post-side-effect crash case is scoped to the idempotent indexing consumer and does not claim exactly-once semantics for arbitrary external systems.
Provider unavailability is injected at the document-intelligence routing boundary.
The MCP scenario proves independence of the core API while MCP is absent; it does not emulate a connected MCP client losing its transport mid-request.
PPR is currently an in-process, on-demand retrieval operation rather than a durable queued job; the resilience matrix proves cooperative cancellation semantics at the bounded operation boundary.
